message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2013 Sorento. From the photos, the headlights look a bit hazy and the black trim on the rear bumper and lower sides has faded to gray, and there are a few light scuffs on the front fender. We do mobile pre-sale details that come to you, including headlight and trim restoration and scuff touch-ups. Would you like a quote?
